name: amend-plan accepts a direct amendment while the plan is pending

source.assertion:
assert_equals "a direct pending amendment leaves approval pending" pending \
  "$(oso-state --session "$SESSION" get plan_approval)"

assert_equals "a direct pending amendment increments the operational plan revision" \
  1 "$(oso-state --session "$SESSION" get plan_revision)"

assert_equals "a pending amendment never mutates the immutable presented snapshot" \
  "$first_plan_document" "$(cat "$first_presented_file" 2>/dev/null || true)"

state_before..local/state/oso-code/{repo}.state:
mode=plan
active_slice=none
verify_green=false
plan_approval=pending
plan_approval_digest=d3f0dbd7d1c0f9e0e2ed69b9b3b30a3c1f5e6fbef5db1cf4c7fdc23c4a8e0dcb
plan_approval_session=test-session
plan_snapshot_file={home}/.local/state/oso-code/plans/{repo}/presented-d3f0dbd7d1c0f9e0e2ed69b9b3b30a3c1f5e6fbef5db1cf4c7fdc23c4a8e0dcb.md
plan_current_file={home}/.local/state/oso-code/plans/{repo}/current.md
plan_revision=0
session=test-session
